Description: A unique identifier for each employee who participated in the training program
The date on which the training session took place
The name or title of the training program attended by the employee
The categorization of the training indicating its purpose or focus
The observed outcome or result of the training for the employee
The physical or virtual location where the training session was conducted
The name of the trainer or instructor who facilitated the training
The duration of the training program in days
The cost associated with organizing and conducting the training program
